children: The technology veteran brings over three decades of experience in enterprise IT, digital transformation and industrial technology

Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd has appointed Kishore Hirani as Group Chief Information Officer (CIO), bringing on board a technology leader with more than three decades of experience across enterprise IT, digital transformation and technology-led business operations.

Hirani joins from Amara Raja Group, where he served as President and Chief Digital and Information Officer (CDIO), leading the group’s technology strategy and digital transformation initiatives across its businesses. His responsibilities included enterprise systems, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, IT governance and digital manufacturing.

Before Amara Raja, Hirani served as Chief Information Officer at Adani Ports and Logistics and held a similar leadership role at Gujarat Gas, part of the BG Group. These assignments gave him experience in managing technology functions across large infrastructure, logistics and energy businesses.

Earlier in his career, he spent nearly 13 years with GE, where he led the GE Energy India SAP and IT Centre. He began his professional journey at Mukand Ltd in process computerisation and also worked as a software engineer with Blue Star Infotech.

In his new role, Hirani will focus on aligning enterprise technology with business priorities, strengthening digital capabilities and supporting operational efficiency as Lloyds Metals expands its mining, metals and critical minerals operations. His experience in enterprise resource planning, digital manufacturing, data systems and information security is expected to support the company’s technology modernisation agenda.

The appointment comes as Lloyds Metals pursues expansion across its integrated mining and metals value chain, alongside investments in critical minerals and supporting infrastructure. Hirani’s mandate will be to help build technology capabilities that can support the group’s growing operational scale and evolving business requirements.
